periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal slant approximately 35 degrees relative to the horizontal snout axis, extending upward toward the posterior.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Distinctly oval with a length-to-width ratio of approximately 1.7:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Visible downward tapering toward the anterior margin, creating a teardrop-like effect with the lowest point shifted forward of the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped posterior boundary at the interface between the black shoulder band and the white dorsal fur.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, covering the entire scapular region and approximately 30 percent of the visible lateral torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Separation distance approximately 1.5 times the width of a single ear base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, semi-circular convex curvature with no visible flattening or irregularities.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a transverse bamboo stalk held in the oral cavity, partially occluding the mandibular region.
